name: Bù chuān qúnzǐ de biànlì shāngdiàn
source:
Hajime Motoki. A 29-year-old single guy. He's traveled the world, but now he's back in his hometown to fulfill his mother's dying wishes.
Taking his life savings, he opens a convenience store.
Experience the bitter-sweet love story between Hajime and his employees as he struggles to manage his new venture.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01056550.html]DLsite English[/url]]
